prompts.luna_izq: Moonlit night scene. Everything is bathed in cold blue moonlight coming from the right: silver-blue rim light on the ridges, deep navy-blue shadows in every gully, strong blue color grading, local colors desaturated by the moonlight, very dark sky with a few stars. The landscape covers the whole mountain from base to summit. Treat the mountain as one continuous surface texture: vegetation only as low ground cover or as a continuous canopy seen from above, no isolated tall trees, no tall cacti, no poles, no vertical objects, no buildings. The beauty comes from color, rock texture, strata and the raking light that sculpts every ridge and gully. San Luis landscape: low sierras with dry golden grassland, low thorny scrub and scattered rocks.
